blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: RAG systems often assign evidence selection and answer generation to separate models. A cross-encoder reranker encodes each query–passage pair separately, typically in batches [ 13 , 6 ] ; LLM-based rerankers improve quality further [ 19 , 15 , 25 ] at higher cost [ 1 ] . Either way, an additional model must be served and the candidate passages are processed before the generator reads the selected context. The generator is going to read the passages anyway: can it judge all of them using computation shared across passages?
blocks.zh: RAG系统经常将证据选择和答案生成分配给独立的模型. 一个跨编码器重排编码了每个查询 - 通道对,通常分批[13,6];基于LLM的重排编码器以更高的成本[1]进一步提高了质量[19,15,25]. 无论哪种方式,都必须在生成器读取所选上下文之前,提供另一个模型,并处理候选段落。 生成器还是会读出这些段落:它能用共享的计算来判断所有段落吗?

blocks.en: Glance equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter. It prefills the candidate passages once, then evaluates short passage-specific probes that branch from the shared cache, and a 256-dimensional pointer head turns each probe into a relevance score. The same resident backbone then generates the answer (Figure 1 ). In an activated-adapter variant, passage encoding uses the base weights, so generation can continue from the original cache.

blocks.en: Our contributions: 1. Method. Passage-specific relevance probes over one shared passage prefill, read by the generator’s own backbone through a small adapter and pointer head, including on hybrid linear/full-attention backbones (§ 3 ). 2. Evidence. Retrieval results on two BEIR datasets, zero-shot and after short MS MARCO training; downstream QA on HotpotQA under the same generator; and scaling to 200 candidates per shared prefill (§ 4 ). 3. blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Cross-encoders such as monoT5 [ 13 ] and BGE rerankers [ 6 ] score each query–passage pair independently. LLM rerankers score pointwise via yes/no logits [ 25 ] , or listwise via permutation generation [ 19 , 15 ] ; FIRST [ 17 ] reads the ranking from the logits of the first generated token. In-context reranking [ 7 ] uses attention patterns of a frozen LLM over all passages at once. Unlike in-context reranking (attention heuristics, frozen weights) and listwise methods (one permutation or one token for all candidates), Glance attaches a separate trained probe per passage over one shared multi-passage context and reads k k passage-specific relevance scores; unlike Self-RAG [ 2 ] , which judges each passage in its own pass, all judgments come from one shared read.
blocks.zh: 单T5 [13] 和BGE rerankers [6] 等交叉编码器,每个查询-通过对独立得分. LLM再排名者通过"是"/"不是"对数"[25]来分取分,或者通过"活化生成"[19,15]来分取分取分;FIRST[17]读取了从"第一个生成的符"的对数中分取分. in-context reservation [7] 使用被冻结的LLM的注意模式一次地覆盖了所有段落. 与内文重排(意向heuristics,被冻结的重量)和列表方法(所有候选人一个通篇或一个信使)不同,格朗斯每经过一个共享多通道上下文就附加一个单独的经过训练的探测器并读出k个通道特定相关分;与Self-RAG[2]不同,所有判决都来自一个共享读取.

blocks.en: Parallel Context Windows [ 16 ] restart positions per window to process segments independently. TurboRAG [ 12 ] and CacheBlend [ 24 ] precompute and fuse passage KV caches for generation. HyperRAG [ 1 ] caches document-side KV offline for decoder rerankers and reports 2–3 × \times throughput with no loss in accuracy. The Kev runtime [ 14 ] packs many typed questions over one shared state, continuing each question branch from the state’s cache, including on hybrid Qwen3.5-style backbones; we build on it and apply it to reranking inside RAG. Activated LoRA [ 8 ] applies an adapter only after an invocation sequence so that the base model’s KV cache can be reused for generation; our main pipeline re-prefills the selected passages (§ 3.4 ), and § 4.7 adopts activation to reuse the cache.
blocks.zh: 平行上下文 Windows [16] 每个窗口重启位置,以独立处理片段. TurboRAG [12]和CacheBlend [24] 预计算和引信通过 KV缓存生成. HyperRAG [1] 缓存文档- 侧 KV 下线用于解码器重排并报告 2–3 ×\时间吞吐量,准确性没有损失. Kev runtime [14] 将许多打出的问题包在一个共享状态上, 从该州的缓存中延续每个问题分支, 包括混合的 Quen3.5 风格的骨干; 我们以此为基础, 激活的LORA [8] 只有在引用序列后才应用适配器,这样该基模型的 KV 缓存才能被再利用生成;我们的主管重新预装了所选的段落(§ 3.4), 第 4.7 则采用活化来再利用缓存.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview and the two answer pipelines
blocks.zh: 3.1 概况和两个答复管道

blocks.en: Glance has two variants, which differ only in where the adapter is active and how the answer is produced (Figure 1 ). • Glance (main). The decision adapter is active on all tokens. Prefill the candidates → \rightarrow score the probes → \rightarrow select the top- n n passages → \rightarrow re-prefill the selected passages with the adapter off → \rightarrow answer. • Glance-Activated. The adapter is active only on probe tokens. Prefill the candidates with the base weights → \rightarrow score the probes with the adapter → \rightarrow continue the original cache with the base weights → \rightarrow answer. The continued cache retains all k k candidates; losing passages are not removed from it. All experiments use the main pipeline except § 4.7 . Table 1 lists the adapter configurations.

blocks.en: 3.4 Hybrid backbones
blocks.zh: 3.4 混合骨干

blocks.en: Our 9B backbone interleaves Gated DeltaNet [ 23 ] linear-attention layers with full-attention layers (3:1). An attention mask can isolate branches in full-attention layers, but a linear-attention layer carries a single recurrent state through the sequence. Kev’s shared-prefix path therefore runs the shared state once and starts every branch from a copy of each layer’s cache at the end of the state: keys and values for attention layers, and the convolution window plus recurrent state for DeltaNet layers (the chunked delta rule’s initial_state ). This is exact, and the same path is used in training, so the state is computed once per record rather than once per question. Unlike attention KV, a DeltaNet state summarises the whole prefix in order, so per-passage caches cannot be stitched in arbitrary order; the main pipeline therefore re-prefills the selected passages (about 1.5k tokens), also because its state cache was computed with the adapter on, while Glance-Activated continues the full candidate cache.
blocks.zh: 我们的9B骨干互出 Gated DeltaNet [23] 有全心全意层的线性关注层 (3:1). 注意口罩可以在全心层中将分枝隔离出,但线性注意口层通过序列带出单一的重复状态. Kev的共享前缀路径因此运行了共享状态一次, 并在状态结束时从每层缓存的复制件中启动每个分支: 注意层的密钥和值, 以及 DeltaNet 层的再生状态( 被分割的三角洲规则的初始状态) 。 这是准确的,在训练中使用同样的路径,因此,每张记录一次计算状态,而不是每问一次。 与注意KV不同的是,一个DeltaNet状态按顺序概括了整个前缀,因此每个通道缓存不能被任意地缝合;因此主管重新预装了所选的通道(约1.5k个令牌),也因为其状态缓存是用适配器计算的,而Glance-Activated则延续了全部候选缓存.

blocks.en: 3.6 Training
blocks.zh: 3.6 培训

blocks.en: We fine-tune from an existing general decision adapter on 4,000 MS MARCO [ 3 ] training queries (Tevatron BM25 hard negatives). Each record packs one positive and 7–19 hard negatives, shuffled, in the packed_all format, with one binary label per probe. One epoch (500 optimizer steps, 55,598 labelled probes, 7.7M forward tokens), LoRA rank 16, learning rate 5 ⋅ 10 − 5 5\cdot 10^{-5} (head 10 − 4 10^{-4} ), batch 8, bf16, on one NVIDIA B200 in 39 minutes with 21 GiB peak GPU memory. No BEIR or HotpotQA data is used in training.

blocks.en: Backbone. MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B (XiaomiMiMo), a hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full-attention model (3:1), frozen in bf16. Zero-shot adapter. “Zero-shot” denotes the general decision adapter (rank-16 LoRA + pointer head), trained for 20 minutes on 4.4k public and synthetic decision records (e.g. BoolQ, topic and sentiment classification, paraphrase, sentence-level answer containment); the mixture contains no MS MARCO, BEIR or HotpotQA data. Retrieval. BM25 (bm25s) top- k = 20 k{=}20 over each corpus; passages truncated to 220 words. Datasets. BEIR [ 20 ] SciFact [ 21 ] (300 test queries) and NFCorpus [ 5 ] (323 test queries), nDCG@10. Baselines. BM25 order; bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder [ 6 ] ; the same decision model scoring each passage in a separate, sequential call ( separate , passage as state, query as question). Hardware. One RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB) for zero-shot runs; latencies are median per query, bf16, without CUDA graphs or fused kernels, on a GPU shared with other jobs, so latencies may differ under isolated execution and ratios between methods are approximate. Training, the trained-adapter evaluations and § 4.4 and § 4.9 use one B200, and § 4.7 one H100; latencies are comparable only within a section. BEIR differences are not significance-tested; at n ≈ 300 n\approx 300 , gaps below about 0.02 nDCG@10 should be read as indicative.

blocks.en: Without any retrieval training, every one-pass mode improves on BM25, and on SciFact the shared-passages mode (packed_all) keeps most of the quality of 20 separate decision calls (0.715 vs. 0.729 nDCG@10) 3.6 × \times faster than sequential pointwise calls to the same 9B model in this shared-GPU experiment, close to the dedicated cross-encoder (0.721). On NFCorpus, packed_all scores highest in Table 2 (0.341, within 0.02 of listwise and packed_q), above the cross-encoder (0.326) and above the same model’s 20 isolated calls (0.323), at 3.7 × \times lower latency than the latter; one plausible explanation is that each probe can compare a passage with its neighbours, which isolated scoring cannot do, although on SciFact the isolated calls are slightly better. The cross-encoder remains far faster per query (31–60 ms). In a 20-query pilot on SciFact with less GPU contention, packed_all scored 0.699 nDCG@10 against 0.697 for 20 separate calls at half the latency (0.60 s vs. 1.20 s), so the speed-up ratio depends on load; on Kev’s fp32-exact evaluation path, which recomputes the state for every question, the same packed request took 16.2 s, so computing the shared state once is what makes single-pass reranking practical.

blocks.en: 4.4 How far does one pass scale?
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 一个比分有多远?

blocks.en: We vary the number of candidates read in one pass, k ∈ { 10 , 20 , 50 , 100 , 200 } k\in\{10,20,50,100,200\} , on the first 100 SciFact queries with passages trimmed to 100 words (Table 4 ). The zero-shot adapter peaks at k = 20 k{=}20 and degrades at k = 100 k{=}100 . The MS MARCO-trained adapter, although trained only on 8–20 passages per record, instead improves with k k : at k = 100 k{=}100 (21.6k context tokens in one pass) it reaches 0.682 nDCG@10, against 0.637 for the cross-encoder scoring the same 100 candidates. A further 14 minutes of training on records with 20–80 passages ( trained-long ) raises every evaluated k k (20–100) again, to 0.697 at k = 100 k{=}100 (+0.060 over the cross-encoder, 1.05 s per query on a B200). At k = 200 k{=}200 (43.4k tokens), which no longer fits in one call and runs on Kev’s chunked path (one prefill of the state, probe rows in several batches; 15.8 s per query), it reaches 0.717 against 0.659 for the cross-encoder on the same 100 queries. Training thus prevents the observed degradation through k = 100 k{=}100 in this study, which suggests that it is not an inherent limit of shared-prefill reranking. The cross-encoder scores lower here than in Table 2 , presumably because of the 100-query subset and the shorter passages.

blocks.en: Memory grows faster than linearly in k k (56 GiB at k = 100 k{=}100 ), because in the current implementation every probe branch continues from its own copy of the shared state’s attention cache, so memory scales with k × k\times context length. Under a 64 GiB cap, the zero-shot single call runs out of memory at k = 200 k{=}200 (43k tokens); Kev’s chunked serving path (state once, branch rows in chunks) still runs k = 200 k{=}200 and k = 300 k{=}300 (65k tokens, 23 GiB, about 22 s per query), but the zero-shot adapter’s quality collapses there (0.505 on 38 queries at k = 200 k{=}200 ). Batching across queries does not help with the current implementation: packing B B queries ( k = 20 k{=}20 ) into one call lowers throughput from 2.87 queries/s ( B = 1 B{=}1 ) to 1.57 ( B = 16 B{=}16 ) and runs out of memory at B = 32 B{=}32 , with scores within bf16 noise of unbatched ones (mean | Δ ​ p | |\Delta p| 0.002). States of different lengths are left-padded, which forces an explicit mask instead of the flash kernel, and each branch row copies its state’s cache, so batching multiplies the copies. Letting all branches attend to one shared cache with a block mask would remove this copy and make memory linear in context length; with it, a reranker over a 128k-token shared prefill becomes feasible, which we leave to future work.

blocks.en: 4.5 End to end: the same weights rerank and answer
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 结束到结束: 相同的加权重新排序并回答

blocks.en: On HotpotQA distractor [ 22 ] (first 300 validation questions; 10 paragraphs per question, 2 gold; paragraphs trimmed to 220 words), one bf16 copy of the 9B backbone serves both roles: Glance reranks with the decision adapter on, then the same backbone answers greedily (at most 48 new tokens). We compare answer EM/F1 (official HotpotQA scoring) given (a) all 10 paragraphs, (b) top-3 by bge-reranker-v2-m3, (c) top-3 by Glance, answering with the adapter off, (b ′ )/(c ′ ) the top-3 of (b)/(c), answering with the adapter left on, and (d) the 2 gold paragraphs.

blocks.en: Although the cross-encoder retrieves more gold paragraphs (R@2 0.863 vs. 0.762), the generator answers better from Glance’s top-3 (F1 0.718 vs. 0.683), consistent with the generator selecting context it can use; this adapter-off gap is not significant (below), and (c) is level with giving the generator all 10 paragraphs (0.716). Answering with the adapter left on raises F1 further to 0.757, within 0.032 of the gold-paragraph ceiling; its answers are shorter (2.5 vs. 3.1 words on average), which matches HotpotQA’s short-answer format. To separate this answer-style effect from reranking, row (b ′ ) answers from the cross-encoder’s top-3 with the same adapter-on generator: Glance’s context still wins by + 0.055 +0.055 F1 (paired bootstrap 95% CI [ + 0.018 , + 0.093 ] [+0.018,+0.093] , 10,000 resamples) and + 0.043 +0.043 EM ( [ + 0.003 , + 0.083 ] [+0.003,+0.083] ). With the adapter off the gap is + 0.035 +0.035 F1 ( [ − 0.003 , + 0.074 ] [-0.003,+0.074] ), positive but not significant at n = 300 n{=}300 .
blocks.zh: 虽然交叉编码器取回了更多黄金段落(R@2 0.863 vs. 0.762),但生成器从Glance的上行-3(F1 0.718 vs. 0.683)中解答得更好,符合其可以使用的生成器上下文的选择;这个适配器-关闭漏洞并不显著(下行),并(c)是水平,赋予生成器所有10个段落(0.716). 在金段天花板上0.032分之内,与留入的适配器的F1再提高到0.757分;其答案更短(平均2.5对3.1个字),与HotpotQA的短答格式相匹配. 要将这种解答式效果与再排区分开来,行 (b ) 用相同的适配器生成器从交叉编码器上到上到下回答: 格朗斯的上下文仍以+0.055+0.055 F1(被放出靴子的95% CI [+0.018,+0.093] [+0.018,+0.093],10,000再标)和+0.043+0.043 EM([+0.003,+0.083] [+0.003,+0.083])取胜. 随着适配器从相差处脱落为+0.035+0.035 F1 ( [−0.003, + 0.074] [-0.03,+ 0.074]),正但值为n=300n{=}300.

blocks.en: With the adapter unmerged, switching modes changes no weights. Over 20 alternations of a real 10-passage rerank (adapter on) and a real 24-token generation (adapter off), entering adapter-off took 11 ms (median) and leaving it 2.8 ms; every on-visit produced bit-identical probabilities and every off-visit the identical greedy answer, and allocated GPU memory stayed at 16.77 GiB (14.78 GiB backbone, 0.08 GiB LoRA, 1.89 GiB LM head).
blocks.zh: 随着适配器被解开,切换模式会改变不重. 超过20次换乘,真实的10个通道重新排位(适应器接上)和真实的24个接地一代(适应器接下),进入适应器接地取出11米(中间)并留下2.8米;每一次访问都产生比特-等同概率和每一次不访问相同的贪婪答案,分配的GPU内存保持在16.77 GiB(14.78 GiB骨干,0.08 GiB LoRA,1.89 GiB LM头).

blocks.en: On general prompts (an explanation, a translation, an arithmetic word problem) adapter-on and adapter-off outputs were identical or nearly so, and the per-token NLL on 1,024 tokens of Wikipedia text rose only from 1.556 to 1.564 (perplexity 4.74 to 4.78). On these prompts the decision LoRA changes general generation little, though on HotpotQA it measurably shortens answers; whether a single adapted model can replace toggling needs broader evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在一般的提示上(解释,翻译,算术字问题),适配器上和适配器上输出的相近等同,而1 024个维基百科文本符号上的每克NLL只从1.556升至1.564(复杂度4.74升至4.78). 在这些激励下,LORA决定对普通一代的改变很小,不过在HotpotQA问题上,它大大缩短了答案;一个经过调整的单一模型是否能够取代更广泛的评价。

blocks.en: With the trained adapter (lower block of Table 5 ), Glance also retrieves more gold paragraphs than the cross-encoder (R@2 0.897 vs. 0.863), and under the same base generator (adapter off) its top-3 improves answer F1 from 0.684 to 0.729 ( + 0.045 +0.045 , paired bootstrap 95% CI [ + 0.014 , + 0.076 ] [+0.014,+0.076] ). This comparison isolates the effect of selecting different evidence from any effect of the adapter on answer style. With the trained adapter left on for both contexts the gap is + 0.065 +0.065 ( [ + 0.038 , + 0.094 ] [+0.038,+0.094] ), but the trained adapter-on F1 (0.747) is below the zero-shot one (0.757), suggesting that the two adapters affect answer style differently. The lower-recall-but-better-answers pattern of the zero-shot adapter is consistent with useful evidence selection, but it does not show that the model has learned answer utility; our training labels are passage relevance, not answer quality. The adapter-off cross-encoder and all-paragraph rows of this run differ from the upper block by at most 0.003 F1 presumably because of bf16 kernel differences between GPUs.
blocks.zh: 随着训练有素的适配器(表5下方块),格朗斯还取回了比交叉编码器(R@2 0.897 vs. 0.863)更多的黄金段落,而在同一基起器(适配器)下,它的上行-3改进了F1的回答从0.684到0.729(+0.045+0.045,配对的靴子圈为95% CI [+0.014,+0.076] [+0.014,+0.076]). 这种比较将选择不同证据的效果与适配器对答案样式的任何效果相隔离. 由于训练有素的适配器留作两种上下文,相差为+0.065+0.065 ([+0.038,+0.094] [+0.038,+0.094]),但训练有素的适配器-上F1 (0.747)低于零发一 (0.757),说明两个适配器对回答风格的影响不同. 零发适配器的下回调-但更好的回答模式与有用的证据选择一致,但并不显示该模式已经学会了答案的效用;我们的培训标签是段落相关性,而不是回答质量. 此跑道的适配器向外的交叉编码器和全段行与上行的相差最多为0.003 F1,大概是因为GPU之间的bf16内核差异.

blocks.en: 4.6 Three modes on one backbone
blocks.zh: 4.6 (中文(简体) ). 一个骨干上的三个模式

blocks.en: Because both the general decision adapter and the reranking adapter are LoRA modules over the same frozen backbone, a single resident copy can serve three modes, chosen per request: base chat (all adapters off), general decisions (the general adapter and its pointer head), and rerank (the MS MARCO adapter and its own head). We load the backbone once, attach the second adapter as a named PEFT adapter with its own head, and cycle base → \to general → \to rerank for 10 rounds (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 由于一般决定适配器和再排适配器都是同被冻结的主干上方的LORA模块,因此一个单一的常驻副本可以服务三种模式,每个请求选择:基础聊天(所有适配器关闭),一般决定(一般适配器及其指针头),再排好(MS MARCO适配器及其自己的头). 我们装入了主干线一次,将第二个适配器作为名为PEFT的适配器加装了自己的头部,循环基座~~到一般~~重新排行10发(表6).

blocks.en: Table 6: One 9B backbone, three modes, switched per request. Memory: 16.85 GiB resident (backbone 14.78, each LoRA 0.08, both heads 0.016, LM head 1.89 GiB), unchanged after the loop (16.86 GiB).
blocks.zh: 表6:1个9B主干线,3个模式,每个请求切换. 记忆:16.85 GiB常住地(backbone 14.78,每个LORA 0.08,两头都为0.016,LM 头为1.89 GiB),循环后不变(16.86 GiB).

blocks.en: Each extra decision skill costs about 0.1 GiB. On the same inputs the two adapters’ probabilities differ by up to 0.81, so the modes are genuinely distinct. Skill retention. On the 231 public items of JevBench [ 4 ] , a benchmark of typed decision requests in easy, original and hard tiers (the hard tier holds adversarial and multi-step items), the general adapter scores 184/231 (79.7%) and the reranking adapter, warm-started from it, 175/231 (75.8%), a net loss of 9 items, 7 of them in the hard tier. Specialising one adapter for reranking therefore causes moderate forgetting of general decisions, which the multi-adapter setup sidesteps: each request uses the adapter trained for it.
blocks.zh: 每个额外决策技能大约花费了0.1 GiB. 在同一投入上,两个适配器的概率相差可达0.81,因此这些模式是真正不同的。 技能保留。 Jev Bench [4] 的231个公共项目上,以简单,原始和硬等分(硬等分有对抗和多步等分)键入决定请求的基准,一般适配器的得分为184/231分(79.7%)和再排适配器,从中温起取出175/231分(75.8%),净损失9个项目,其中7个为硬等分. 因此,专门使用一个适配器进行再排位,会导致温和地忘记一般的决定,而多适配器设置了旁接:每个请求都使用为此而训练的适配器.

blocks.en: 4.7 Activated adapter: one read for reranking and answering
blocks.zh: 4.7 (中文(简体) ). 激活适配器:一个读取重排并回答

blocks.en: In the runs above the LoRA is active on every token, so the state is read by an adapted model and its cache is not the base model’s. For Glance-Activated, following Activated LoRA [ 8 ] , we switch the adapter off for the state pass and on only for the probe branches (the invocation point is the first probe token), in both training and inference, by patching Kev’s shared-prefix step. On a 0.8B Qwen3.5 check, the patched adapter-on state cache equals the base model’s bitwise (48 tensors: attention KV, DeltaNet convolution and recurrent states; max | Δ | = 0 |\Delta|=0 , vs. 8.18 unpatched), while branch outputs still differ from the base.
blocks.zh: 在LORA上面的跑道中,每个符号都活动,所以状态被一个被修改的模型所读取,它的缓存不是基模型的. 对于Glance-Actionated,在激活了LORA[8]之后,我们将适配器切换为状态通关,并且仅用于探测分支(引出点是第一个探测符),在训练和推论上,通过补合Kev的共享前缀步骤. 在0.8B Quen3.5 检查中,补丁的适配器-on状态缓存等于基准模型的位数(48个分数:注意KV, DeltaNet  convolution and revention states; max | = 0 |\ Delta|=0, vs 8.18 un propert),而分支输出与基准仍然不同.

blocks.en: Quality. We train the activated adapter for 150 steps (1,200 MS MARCO records, H100, 17 minutes) and a matched control with the LoRA on all tokens (same data, steps and seed). The activated adapter reaches 0.740 / 0.351 nDCG@10 on SciFact / NFCorpus (packed_all, k = 20 k{=}20 ), against 0.744 / 0.351 for the control: reranking scores are similar in this matched experiment.
blocks.zh: 质量. 我们训练起动适配器150步(1,200 MS MARCO记录,H100,17分钟),并在所有道具(同数据,步和种子)上与LORA相匹配的控制. 活化适配器在SciFact / NFCorpus上达到0.740/0.351 nDCG@10 (packed_all,k = 20 k{=}20),而控制器则达到0.744/0.351:在这个相匹配的实验中重新排位分数相似.

blocks.en: Chat. Without probe tokens the activated model runs the exact base weights, so its greedy chat output is identical to the base by construction; the control adapter already changes the wording on one of two test prompts.
blocks.zh: 说吧 没有探测符,被激活的模型会运行精确的基重,因此其贪婪的聊天输出通过构造与基重完全相同;控制适配器已经在两个测试提示中的一个上修改了措辞.

blocks.en: Cache reuse. Because the state cache is now the base model’s own, generation can continue from it. On 100 HotpotQA distractor questions (10 paragraphs, median state 1.4k tokens, H100 not shared): the state pass takes 64 ms, the 10 probes fork from its cache in 85 ms (R@3 0.97), and the base model then answers by continuing the same cache with the question in the chat format. Continuing the cache gives EM/F1 0.61 / 0.750 against 0.59 / 0.754 for re-prefilling the top-3 passages, with a lower answer latency (138 ms vs. 181 ms median). On 5 checked questions the continued answer equals that of a fresh base-model prefill of the same text. Telling the model which passages scored highest added nothing at this scale, and a continuation without the chat turn markers is much worse (F1 0.577). In this mode the generator sees all passages; the reranking scores do not select its context. The passages are thus prefilled once for both reranking and answering; the continued cache still contains all 10 candidates. This is a 100-question, single-seed result.
blocks.zh: 缓存复用. 因为现在国家缓存是基建模型的自有,所以世代可以从中延续. 在100 HotpotQA分心问题(10个段落,中位态为1.4k令牌,H100不共享):状态通关取64ms,10个探测器从它的缓存中取出85ms(R@3 0.97)分叉,然后通过在聊天格式中继续同样的缓存来解答. 继续缓存会给EM/F1 0.61 / 0.750对0.59 / 0.754重新预装出上行至上行至上行行至上行至上行至上行至上行至下行至上行至下行至下行至上行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行至下行行至下行至下行行行至下行至下行行行至下行行行行至下行行行行行行行行 关于5个问题,继续回答相当于对同一文本进行新的基本模型预填。 告诉哪些段落得分最高的模型在这个尺度上没有增加任何内容,没有聊天转弯标记的续作更糟糕(F1 0.577)。 在此模式下,生成器会看到所有段落;重新排序的分数不会选择上下文. 因此,重新排位和回答的段落预先填入一次;持续的缓存仍然包含所有10名候选人。 这是一个100个问题,单一种子的结果。

blocks.en: 4.8 Order sensitivity
blocks.zh: 4.8 顺序敏感性

blocks.en: In packed_all every probe sees all passages, so scores can depend on passage order. On 100 SciFact queries (220-word passages, as in Table 3 ) with the MS MARCO-trained adapter, we score each query’s 20 candidates in BM25 order and in 4 random orders. nDCG@10 ranges from 0.678 (BM25 order) to 0.693 across orders (per-query standard deviation 0.020); averaging scores over the 5 orders gives 0.689. The median per-passage probability changes by 10 − 4 10^{-4} across orders (90th percentile 0.033, maximum 0.36), and the top-ranked passage is the same as under BM25 order in 91% of cases. Order effects are therefore small on average but not negligible for individual passages, and the slightly lower score in BM25 order may indicate a mild position effect.
blocks.zh: 在打包的_每个探测器都看到所有通道,因此分数可以取决于通过顺序. 在100个SciFact查询(220个字段,如表3)中,我们用MS MARCO训练的适配器,以BM25顺序和4个随机顺序对每个查询的20个考生进行分分. nDCG@10从0.678(BM25订单)到0.693,跨订单(per-query标准差为0.020);5个订单的平均得分给出了0.689. 每条通道的中位概率变化为10-4 10-QQ-4},跨越订单(第90百分位数0.033,最高0.36),排名最高的通道与91%的BM25顺序下相同. 因此,顺序效应平均来说很小,但对于个别通道来说并非可忽略不计,而BM25顺序中略低的分数可能表示轻度位置效应.

blocks.en: 4.9 Serving chat and decisions in one vLLM engine
blocks.zh: 4.9 (中文(简体) ). 在一个 vLLM 引擎中提供聊天和决定

blocks.en: vLLM [ 10 ] has no pointer head, but it can expose hidden states. We serve the base model with the reranking LoRA registered as a vLLM adapter: chat requests use no adapter, decision rows are one-token requests with the adapter, and the residual stream at the readout positions is passed through the final norm and the 256-dimensional pointer head outside the engine. Rows of one request share the state through vLLM’s prefix cache on the hybrid model. In a single generate call, 4 chat answers (48 tokens each) and the 19 decision rows of one packed request completed in 0.76 s, against 0.43 s for the 4 chats alone. On 20 SciFact packed requests (400 probes), probabilities differ from Kev by 0.006 on average (maximum 0.10, about 2.6 × \times the 0.039 spread between Kev’s two bf16 inference paths, the default and the shared-prefix fast path), per-query Spearman rank correlation 0.995, with 4 of 400 decisions flipped; serving throughput on a shared B200 was 1.54 requests/s vs. 0.86 for Kev’s sequential fast path. Production use needs a connector that exports only the readout positions and the head inside the engine.
blocks.zh: vLLM [10] 没有指针头,但它可以暴露隐藏状态. 我们以重新排列注册为vLLM适配器的LORA为基准模型服务:聊天请求不使用适配器,决定行是和适配器的一键请求,读取位置的剩余流会通过最终规范与引擎外的256维指针头来传递. 一个请求的行通过混合模型上vLLM的前缀缓存共享状态. 在一次生成呼叫中,4个聊天回答(每个48个令牌)和一个打包请求的19个决定行在0.76 s中完成,而仅4个聊天则0.43 s. 在20个SciFact打包请求(400个探针)上,概率与Kev平均差0.06(最大为0.10个,约2.6×\相差于Kev的两个bf16推断路径,默认和共享-前置快路径),每克斯皮尔曼排名0.995,400个裁决中有4个翻了;在共享的B200上完成的吞吐量为1.54个请求/s相差0.86个,为Kev的相接快路径. 生产用途需要一个连接器,只输出读出位置和引擎内头.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: This is a proof of concept. Evaluation sets are small (hundreds of queries) and cover two BEIR datasets and one QA dataset. We test one backbone family (hybrid 9B). Latencies are from an unoptimised eager path; a dedicated cross-encoder remains faster per query. The shared-state construction itself is provided by the Kev runtime; our contribution is its use and training for reranking inside RAG with the generator’s own weights. In packed_all every probe sees all passages, so a passage’s score depends somewhat on its neighbours and on order (§ 4.8 ); averaging over orders is a simple remedy. BEIR differences are not significance-tested, and the per-passage baseline was not re-run with the trained adapter. Latencies come from different, partly shared GPUs (RTX PRO 6000, B200, H100), and speed-up ratios depend on load. The zero-shot adapter degrades beyond k = 20 k{=}20 and collapses at k = 200 k{=}200 ; batching across queries currently lowers throughput. The activated-adapter and cache-reuse results are single-seed, on 100 questions, the bitwise cache check used a 0.8B model, and with cache reuse the answer sees all passages rather than the reranked subset. Chat quality with the adapter on was checked on a handful of prompts, and specialising the adapter for reranking loses 9 JevBench items. Memory currently grows with k × k\times context length (§ 4.4 ), and the vLLM path is a prototype whose probabilities differ from Kev’s by 0.006 on average (maximum 0.10; 4 of 400 decisions flipped; § 4.9 ).
blocks.zh: 这是概念的证明。 评价组规模小(有上百个查询),涵盖两个BEIR数据集和一个QA数据集. 我们测试一个骨干家族(hybrid 9B). 晚报来自不理想的急切路径;每个查询都有一个专用的交叉编码器仍然更快. Kev 运行时间提供共享状态建设本身; 我们的贡献是使用该状态, 每一个探测器都看到所有段落, 因此通过得分多少取决于邻居和秩序(第4.8节); BEIR差异没有经过意义测试,每条通道基准没有与经过训练的适配器重运行. 速率来自不同的,部分共享的GPU(RTX PRO 6000, B200, H100),速率取决于负载. 0发适配器可降解出k = 20 k{=}20,并倒塌出k = 200 k{=}200;分批分解查询目前能降低吞吐量. 被激活的适应器和缓存-再用的结果是单种子,在100个问题上,位取缓存检查使用了0.8B模型,而通过缓存再用,答案会看到所有段落而不是被重新排序的子集. 在少数提示上检查了与适配器的聊天质量,并将适配器用于重排9个Jev Bench项目。 内存目前以 k × k\times 上下文长度(§ 4.4)来增长,而 vLLM 路径是一个原型,其概率平均比 Kev 差 0. 06 (最大为 0. 10;400 个裁决中有 4个被翻转;§ 4.9 ) .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Glance shows that the generator can also serve as its reranker. Passage-specific probes share one candidate prefill, while lightweight adapters support ranking and general decisions on a single resident backbone. In the evaluated settings, the resulting rankings are competitive with a dedicated cross-encoder, and they improve downstream QA under the same generator. Probe-only adaptation further allows generation to reuse the original passage cache. The next questions are how these benefits extend across larger benchmarks and backbone families, how far a shared-cache implementation can push the candidate count toward 128k-token contexts, and how optimized serving systems change the latency trade-off against small cross-encoders.
blocks.zh: 光照显示,生成器也可以作为它的重排器. 径向特异性探测器共享一个候选预填,而轻量级适配器则支持对单一常驻骨干进行排名和一般决定. 在被评价的环境下,由此产生的排名与专用交叉编码器具有竞争力,它们在同一生成器下改善下游QA. 仅被探测的适应进一步允许生成重用原始通道缓存. 接下来的问题是,这些福利如何扩展到更大的基准和骨干家庭,共享缓存的执行能在多大程度上将候选人数推向128k-token的背景,以及优化服务系统如何改变相对于小型跨编码器的延迟取舍。
